goals: Skill directory names in `nvst-skills/` and `~/.agents/skills/` match the `nvst` command that loads them.
`loadSkill()` calls in all four affected command handlers use the new names.
All tests and generated manifests are updated to reflect the new names.
No backward-compatibility shims — old names are removed entirely.

userStories.title: Rename skill directories in `nvst-skills/`
userStories.description: As a developer browsing `nvst-skills/` or `~/.agents/skills/`, I want skill folder names to match the `nvst` command that loads them so that I can immediately identify which skill belongs to which phase.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Old directories (`create-pr-document`, `refine-pr-document`, `implement-user-story`) no longer exist in `nvst-skills/`

userStories.title: Update `loadSkill()` calls in command handlers
userStories.description: As a developer reading the source code, I want each command handler to call `loadSkill` with the name matching its own file name so that the relationship between command and skill is obvious.

acceptanceCriteria.text: No other source files reference the old skill names

userStories.title: Update tests that reference old skill names
userStories.description: As a developer running the test suite, I want tests to reference the new skill names so that the suite stays green after the rename.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `tests/implement-user-story-skill.test.ts` is renamed to `tests/create-prototype-skill.test.ts` and all internal references to `implement-user-story` are updated to `create-prototype`
`tests/us-004-skill-migration.test.ts` and `tests/us-003-command-compatibility.test.ts` are updated to reference the new skill names wherever the old names appear
`bun test` passes with no failures related to skill loading

userStories.title: Regenerate the `nvst-skills-manifest.ts`
userStories.description: As a developer distributing NVST, I want the generated manifest to list the new skill names so that the package correctly advertises the available skills.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `bun run src/scripts/generate-nvst-skills-manifest.ts` (or equivalent) is executed after the rename
The resulting `src/nvst-skills-manifest.ts` no longer references `create-pr-document`, `refine-pr-document`, `implement-user-story`, or `automated-fix`

functionalRequirements.description: Skill names must use `kebab-case` (matching existing convention — e.g. `define-requirement`, not `define_requirement`).
The rename is a hard rename — no aliases or fallback lookups for old names.
All three renames must be applied atomically in a single iteration; partial renames are not acceptable.
